description: The Army Contracting Command (ACC) - Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG), Tobyhanna Division, is conducting this sources sought to identify capable vendors that will be able support a quick turn around supply requirement of Ingersoll Rand (or equal) Refrigerated Air Dryer (qty 2), Ingersoll Rand (or equal) Condensate Drain (qty 1) and Ingersoll Rand (or equal) 2” Ball Valve (qty 1) (specifications attached). Everything must arrive to Tobyhanna Army Depot no later than June 5, 2026.
